children: Axens has been awarded a contract by Argentina’s YPF to implement a 5,000 m³/day low-sulphur diesel hydrotreater at its Industrial Complex using Prime-D technology.
The unit will be delivered through prefabricated modules, reducing the project schedule by six months compared with conventional construction.
The modular approach integrates vessels, structures, piping and instrumentation off-site, minimising on-site activity and disruption to refinery operations while optimising capital costs.
Prime-D is Axens’ diesel hydrotreating technology for producing ultra-low-sulphur diesel, offering operational flexibility and reliability.

Jean-Luc Nocca, Executive Vice-President Commercial Business Division, Axens said ”By selecting Axens, YPF will benefit from a highly-proven diesel hydrodesulfurisation technology, Prime-D, confirming Axens’ leading position in very low sulphur diesel applications. We are thankful to YPF to have entrusted Axens for the supply of the unit under modularised form that allows them to benefit from our engineering expertise and reach the shortest time-to-production schedule, while mitigating projects risks especially related to site activities. This project is a strong illustration of the trust and close collaboration established between YPF and Axens.”
